name: v1.37.1+k3s1
body:
<!-- v1.37.1+k3s1 -->

This release updates Kubernetes to v1.37.1, and fixes a number of issues.

For more details on what's new, see the [Kubernetes release notes](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.37.md#changelog-since-v1370).

## Changes since v1.37.0+k3s1:

* Backports for 2026-09 [(#14631)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14631)
  * Fix restore from compressed etcd snapshot #14528
  * Enable seccomp in riscv64 builds #14529
  * Use ginkgo CLI to run tests #14531
  * Bump k3s-io/api to v0.2.0 #14570
  * Servicelb multiple lbpools #14547
  * Close minio.Object after read #14580
  * Bump k3s-io/apis again #14589
  * Fix --flannel-cni-conf not reaching the embedded flannel #14598
  * Check-config: suppress colors when stdout is not a terminal #14595
  * Fix deploy controller not re-applying manifests when mtime is pinned to the epoch #14568
  * Bump etcd to v3.7.1-k3s3 for nonblocking logging support #14628
  * Bump kine to v0.17.1 #14627
* Bump helm-controller [(#14684)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14684)
* Bump k3s-io/kubernetes and Go references [(#14695)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14695)
* Bump cadvisor to v0.60.5-k3s1 [(#14698)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14698)
* Reject anonymous access to supervisor router (spegel/pprof/metrics) [(#14701)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14701)
* Improve CA hash validation [(#14705)](https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/pull/14705)

## Embedded Component Versions
| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| Kubernetes | [v1.37.1](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.37.md#v1371) |
| Kine | [v0.17.1](https://github.com/k3s-io/kine/releases/tag/v0.17.1) |
| SQLite | [3.53.4](https://sqlite.org/releaselog/3_53_4.html) |
| Etcd | [v3.7.1-k3s3](https://github.com/k3s-io/etcd/releases/tag/v3.7.1-k3s3) |
| Containerd | [v2.3.4-k3s1](https://github.com/k3s-io/containerd/releases/tag/v2.3.4-k3s1) |
| Runc | [v1.4.2](https://github.com/opencontainers/runc/releases/tag/v1.4.2) |
| Flannel | [v0.28.4](https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel/releases/tag/v0.28.4) | 
| Metrics-server | [v0.9.0](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/tag/v0.9.0) |
| Traefik | [v3.7.13](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/releases/tag/v3.7.13) |
| CoreDNS | [v1.14.7](https://github.com/coredns/coredns/releases/tag/v1.14.7) | 
| Helm-controller | [v0.17.9](https://github.com/k3s-io/helm-controller/releases/tag/v0.17.9) |
| Local-path-provisioner | [v0.0.37](https://github.com/rancher/local-path-provisioner/releases/tag/v0.0.37) |

## Helpful Links
As always, we welcome and appreciate feedback from our community of users. Please feel free to:
- [Open issues here](https://github.com/rancher/k3s/issues/new/choose)
- [Join our Slack channel](https://slack.rancher.io/)
- [Check out our documentation](https://rancher.com/docs/k3s/latest/en/) for guidance on how to get started or to dive deep into K3s.
- [Read how you can contribute here](https://github.com/rancher/k3s/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
